description: Madulla Pradeshiya Sabha - List of the Roads and Arrow Roads of the Madullal Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property-related matters, specifically the official naming, boundary marking, and gazetting of roads and lanes within the Madulla Pradeshiya Sabha jurisdiction. It contains detailed geographic coordinates, road dimensions, and legal procedures under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act for establishing permanent boundaries - all characteristic of land administration matters.
